name: Mistral Large 4
license: Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (modified MIT; Model-as-a-Service operators need a separate commercial license)
archDisplay: 1.05T-total/52B-active granular MoE with a 1.6B vision encoder; 1M-token context; open weights (Oct 29, 2026) with low/medium/high reasoning modes
note: Mistral's Oct 6, 2026 public preview of its largest model to date: a 1.05T-total/52B-active MoE with a 1.6B vision encoder and 1M context, trained on 3,800 Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. On Oct 29 Mistral released open weights (mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B) for an improved checkpoint with three more weeks of RL, under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (modified MIT; Model-as-a-Service operators need a commercial license), and cut the API price from the preview's $1.36/$4.18 to $0.70/$2.10 per Mtok ($0.07 cached input). The DeepSWE, SWE-Atlas-QnA and self-reported Terminal-Bench 4 rows are from the preview launch post; the Harvey and Finance Agent Vals rows were run on the preview API, while the Vals Terminal-Bench 4 row is the open-weights checkpoint. Not filed from the Oct 29 post: Terminal-Bench 4.0 41% (Artificial Analysis harness, not comparable with the Vals-sourced column), FrontierCode 2.0 19.7% (new version, no column), AA Coding Agent Index 48%, AA Cyber Index 51%, FinWorkBench (Finch) 73.3% and B3 attack resistance 97.1% (no columns). Hugging Face's Oct 29 blog says about 49B active parameters, which conflicts with the docs' 52B; the docs figure is kept.
